balanced_policy.notes: Deterministic max-20-per-label view of frozen W11 test; unsupported/rare labels retain their actual lower support.

real_distribution.notes: Frozen W26 private human-adjudicated real-chat test partition: 566 records (557 ALLOW / 9 BLOCK). Raw text remains private and hash-pinned.

adversarial_evasion.notes: Combines W11 frozen adversarial with W21 untouched family holdout.

context.notes: Frozen W27 later-period context suite: 600 family-isolated records (588 ALLOW / 11 BLOCK / 1 REVIEW), including multi-speaker history, private/Discord contexts, retry/evasion patterns, and cross-platform duplicate controls. Canonical mirror double-count suppression remains a W24 incident-linker responsibility rather than a classifier label.

time_based_real_chat.notes: Frozen W27 later-period time-based suite from 2026-08-26 through 2026-09-09: 2,998 family-isolated records (2,989 ALLOW / 9 BLOCK). A separate strict novel-target analysis contains 2,733 targets absent from W26 train+development.

notes: W20 is not a W25 development/comparison suite and remains unseen until one-shot acceptance.
W11 test is used only for the label-capped balanced policy suite after development choices are frozen.
W11 frozen-adversarial plus W21 untouched families form the separate adversarial/evasion suite.
W26 private test is the real-distribution suite and preserves its production-shaped ALLOW-heavy imbalance.
W27 supplies independent later-period context and time-based real-chat suites; two unresolved animal/pet-harm policy-gap rows are quarantined.
W27 context and time-based partitions are family-disjoint and were frozen without W25 model predictions.
Canonical mirror/double-count suppression is separately covered by the W24 incident-linker prototype; W25 context evidence measures classifier-visible context/channel behavior.
Final ranking requires every candidate to use fingerprint-identical copies of all five frozen suites.
